process_decisions.technology: thermophilic (55 C) anaerobic membrane bioreactor, POME only

vessel.rule: largest transportable vessel with <=15% overshoot in all tiers

process_decisions.efb: not co-digested in the portable module (returned to mill: mulch/boiler)

meta.title: Portable thermophilic AnMBR biogas generator - mass & energy balance

reactor_vessel.transport: 4.2 m x 17.3 m shell, shipped horizontal on low-bed trailer
reactor_vessel.material: CS + epoksi, insulasi 100 mm, pencampuran jet (resirkulasi)

ffb_tph.source: [ASSUME] representative independent mill, t FFB/h nameplate

tan_pome.source: [ASSUME] NH4-N in POME feed, kmol/m3 (35 mg N/L)

so4_pome.source: [ASSUME] sulfate, kmol/m3 (300 mg SO4/L; earlier deck value)

cat_pome.source: [ASSUME] net strong cations in POME (K+ etc. minus Cl-), kmol eq/m3

d_p_mm.source: shredded EFB mean particle size, mm (hammer-mill product)

efb_share.source: [DESIGN] fraction of EFB to AD (re-optimised in Section 8)

TS_max.source: [ASSUME] max blend TS (wet basis) for pumpable, mixable CSTR

e_grit.source: [ASSUME] mineral grit/sand removal in hydrocyclone desander HC-101

srt.source: [DESIGN] solids retention time with membrane, d (0 = plain CSTR, SRT = HRT)

KI_nh3.source: [ADM1x2] free NH3 on acetoclasts, kmol/m3 (acclimated; ADM1 0.0018)

IN_sp.source: [DESIGN] N-dosing set-point, kmol N/m3 (100 mg N/L): keeps TAN above nutrient limitation
